$comment: Advisories that have been READ and judged not to apply to this app.
Not a mute button: audit-gate.mjs fails on anything not listed here, and
ALSO fails once an entry is past `review_by`. An exception that never
expires is how a security gate turns into decoration.
Adding an entry means: you opened the advisory, you can say why this
codebase is not exposed, and you named a date to look again. If you
cannot write the `reason` without hedging, upgrade instead.

allow.title: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
allow.reason: The advisory is specific to React Server Components mode: the bypass lets a server action run before the framework returns 400. This app is a Vite SPA — react-router-dom is used purely for client-side routing, there is no RSC runtime, no server actions and no loader/action server, so the vulnerable code path does not exist in the shipped bundle. There is also no forward fix: the affected range is 7.12.0-8.2.0 and the current release (7.18.2) sits inside it, so npm's suggested remedy is a DOWNGRADE to 7.11.0 — trading a real routing regression for an advisory that cannot fire here.
